title: AI Contextual Profiling Engine: Analyze before acting
goal: Ensure the system NEVER blindly fires 100 tools. Implement a phase 0 'Contextual Profiling' step where the AI performs light, non-intrusive recon (fetching headers, robots.txt, sitemaps, JS source maps). The AI ingests this and builds a 'Target Context Document' that strictly defines the technologies present and dictates exactly which specific tools are relevant.
generation_reason: To ensure the pentest is highly intelligent, targeted, layered, and strictly provable, avoiding blind 'spray and pray' testing.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus strictly on the AI's planning logic and ledger generation. Do not build new testing tools in this task.

success_criteria: AI builds a Context Document before running active tools.
AI generates a nested micro-plan upon finding a new endpoint/layer.
Every tool execution has a corresponding, provable entry in the Rationale Ledger.

acceptance_criteria: Integration tests prove the AI halts, plans, and writes justifications before dispatching tools.

out_of_scope: Modifying the core tool runners themselves
